high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "science_documents." The post features a satellite image of Africa with a blue circle highlighting a specific region in the northern part of the continent. Below the image, there is a caption that reads: "More than 20 African countries have joined together to plant a giant wall of trees that will run across the continent to stop the spread of the Sahara Desert. The Great Green Wall of Africa will stretch for 7,000 kilometers, from coast to coast right across the continent." The post has received 4,336 likes.
